name: Pocket Archive
purpose: Local ROM library, metadata shelf, controller guidance, and emulator launch surface.

filters.style: inline feature style until shell extraction
filters.responsibility: Filter local titles by detected system and type.

scrollGuard.responsibility: Keep the archive document scrollable while the emulator is closed.

detailModal.responsibility: Show local metadata, gallery, controls, save choice, and supported two-player boot.

data.rule: ROMs and their art are user-owned local runtime data and must not be committed.

changeRules: Add new behavior as a named file in assets/scripts/arcade or assets/styles/arcade, then register it here.
Do not add new executable behavior to pages/arcade.html.
A feature owns one concern: input, filtering, modal, import, performance, or display.
Preserve touch, mouse, keyboard, and Xbox paths when changing a feature.
Keep local-only code usable without a remote API.
